steps.subtitle: Departments are optional, but they let you cap whole groups such as IT. Finished steps stay checked.

team.hint: Groups like IT or Sales with a shared budget and rate limits.

project.hint: Applications or integrations that get their own project keys.

member.title: People
member.hint: Individuals who call the API with personal keys and never sign in. Not console users.

budget.hint: Cap spend at any level, for example IT at 5,000 per month. Children cannot exceed parents.

structure.hint: Departments group projects under a shared budget and rate limits. Projects are applications with their own API keys.

people.title: People
people.hint: People call the API with personal keys and never sign in to this console.
people.empty: {manage, select, yes {People are individuals of this company who call the API with personal keys. They never sign in to this console. Add one to give them a key and a budget.} other {People of this company who call the API with personal keys will appear here.}}

keys.title: API keys
keys.hint: Every key billed to this company. Open a key to change its access, limits, or security.
keys.empty: {create, select, yes {An API key lets a project or a person call the gateway. Its spend is billed to them and to this company.} other {API keys of this company's projects and people will appear here.}}

users.title: Console users ({count, number, integer})
users.hint: They sign in to this console and see only this company. People of the company call the API and never sign in.
users.empty: No console user signs in for this company.
